evidence.title: GitHub - google-labs-code/design.md: A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents.

name: DESIGN.md
summary: Format spec and CLI for describing a design system to coding agents: YAML tokens plus markdown rationale.
description: The skills.sh page for the google-labs-code/design.md repo, which carries four agent skills (typed-service-contracts, tdd-red-green-refactor, ink, agent-dx-cli-scale). The repo itself specifies DESIGN.md: machine-readable YAML design tokens with human-readable markdown rationale, validated by an npm CLI with 11 lint rules (broken token references, WCAG contrast, section order), a diff command for token-level regressions, and export to Tailwind v3/v4 and W3C DTCG tokens.
contains: YAML token front matter + markdown rationale
CLI: lint (11 rules), diff, spec, export
export to Tailwind v3/v4 and W3C DTCG tokens
